tokens.name: abyss
tokens.usage: Page ground everywhere: site body, banner backgrounds, README image grounds. A neutral biased toward orchid, never pure black or white.

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: Raised surface on abyss: code blocks, the command palette, note link blocks. Separates by fill, no shadow.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and lattice lines only (1.4:1 on abyss, by design). Never the only border of a control: use haze for that.

tokens.name: fog
tokens.usage: Primary text and the display name, on abyss, night, orchid-soft and aqua-soft (13:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: haze
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, taglines, and control borders, on abyss and night (5.6:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: aqua
tokens.usage: Signal: what moves or can be acted on. Links, the active state, live pulses, strand ends, the focus ring. As text, on abyss, night and aqua-soft (4.7:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: orchid
tokens.usage: Depth: what holds. The lattice, strand roots, structural accents, eyebrow labels on stubs. As text, on abyss, night and orchid-soft (5.1:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: aqua-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind aqua text: an 'evergreen' status chip, a live callout.

tokens.name: orchid-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind orchid or fog text: a 'stub' or 'developing' chip, a quoted note.

tokens.name: on-aqua
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an aqua fill (14:1 dark, 5.7:1 light).

tokens.name: on-orchid
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an orchid fill (6.2:1 dark, 6.7:1 light).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a solid 2px ring with a 2px abyss gap. 13:1 on night in dark, 4.7:1 on night in light.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The name, once per surface. Home hero, banner headline.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase labels above sections and on banners. Set in uppercase in the content, not by transform.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: I build backend systems and, when something feels like magic, the thing underneath it.
styles.usage: The one opening paragraph of a page.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Two-pass resolution precomputes scope distances into a side table, so closure capture is correct and lookups are O(1).

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Inline emphasis and table row headers.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Depth gauge, dates in the log, frontier markers, file paths.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip padding, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between a label and its value.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Minimum side gutter at phone width; paragraph gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between related blocks. Equal to the lattice pitch.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card and banner inner padding.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between sections on a page.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Banner side margins; desktop gutter.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Between descent layers on the home page.

tokens.name: grid
tokens.usage: The lattice pitch. Every grid line, dot and strand root sits on a multiple of it.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, inline code, the eyebrow box.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Code blocks, the command palette, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Banner and image corners; the app-icon form of the mark (22% of its side).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status chips only.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: Lattice lines and decorative rules.

tokens.name: stroke-strand
tokens.usage: Escape strands at banner scale (1.2–2.6px, varied per strand).

tokens.name: stroke-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring width.
